chunks: They will swear by God to you when you return to them, so that you may keep away from them; so keep away from them. Indeed, they are impure; and their abode is Hell, as a recompense for what they used to earn.

key_terms.رِجْسٌ: Impurity or uncleanliness, often referring to spiritual defilement

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about keeping distance from hypocrites who swear by God?
ai.summary: In the context of the Expedition to Tabuk, this verse commands believers to reject the insincere oaths of the Munafiqun who returned from the campaign, emphasizing that their outward piety masks inner corruption. Shia scholarship highlights 'Rijs' not merely as ritual impurity but as a spiritual defilement, justifying the believers' detachment to preserve the purity of the community. This rejection serves as a practical guideline for distinguishing true faith from performative religiosity in times of communal trial.
